message.content:
The quadratic formula \(x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}\) provides the roots of any quadratic equation \(ax^2 + bx + c = 0\).

To solve the following linear system we can add the equations after multiplying the second by an appropriate factor:

$$\begin{align}
x + y &= 5 \\
2x - y &= 1
\end{align}$$

The 2-by-2 identity matrix together with a simple piecewise function are written as

$$I = \begin{pmatrix} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}, \quad
f(x) = \begin{cases}
x^2 & \text{if } x \geq 0 \\
-x & \text{if } x < 0
\end{cases}$$

Three well-known physics and geometry relations appear below:

$$E = mc^2$$
$$F = ma$$
$$a^2 + b^2 = c^2$$

See [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quadratic_formula) for more details on the quadratic formula.
